FN-TOLX99-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 288
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Allen Treadaway
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/21/2023
House Bill 288as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund from fines;
increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general funds, and
other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State
General Fund, local jails, the district attorneys, the Department of Corrections, the Board of
Pardons and Paroles, and community corrections programs by an undetermined amount
dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by
this bill and the penalties imposed.
In addition, this bill could increase the administrative obligations of the Office of Prosecution
Services, Office of the Attorney General, and the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency to
coordinate with the Alabama Association of Chiefs of Police, the Alabama Sheriffs Association,
the Alabama Grocers Association, and the Alabama Retail Association to develop certain
training for prosecutors and law enforcement agencies and provide recommendations to the
Legislature and Governor regarding public safety and prevention of organized retail
crime.
